After reviewing the delivery lead times for each vendor’s laptop quotation:

| Vendor | Delivery Lead Time |
|--------|--------------------|
| Acme Computing Ltd | 14 business days |
| Orbital IT Partners | 10 business days |
| BrightPath Systems | 21 calendar days |
| Nimbus Tech Supply | 7 business days |

**Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply**
